Name: Events Expansion
Author: nraittanna
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=6][b][color=#a64d79]Events Expansion[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[size=3]I've always felt like there should be more casual events for all villagers, showing more of their relationship and how they get along with each other, so I've written a few new heart events for them :)
[/size]
[size=5][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patc[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]her[/url] must be installed.﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the mod and unzip it.[/size]
[*][size=3]Place the folder [b][CP] Events Expansion[/b] in your Mods folder.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Heart events info:
[/size][/b][size=3]Note: I included some non-romantic events from my other mod Life Cycle, you can play with both mods installed and there won't be any problems.
Currently there are 24 new heart events.
[/size]

[size=5][b]Future updates:[/b]
[/size][size=3]I intend to add more events for all villagers, for most of them there won't be direct interaction with the farmer and will be friendly. I want to add more immersion to the game and make all villagers interact with each other. If you have any suggestions, leave a post to let me know![/size]

[size=5][b]FAQ:[/b][/size]
[color=#d5a6bd][size=3][b]Is this mod compatible with others?[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Events Expansion is compatible with all mods in a technical level, but there might be inconsistencies in the villagers' story.
Note that if some of your mods edit maps, the NPCs might break through objects or stand in places where new objects were added.
[/size][color=#d5a6bd][size=3][b]Can I install it on an existing file?[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Yes.

If you enjoy playing with my mods, please consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/nraittanna]buying me a coffee [/url][img]https://forums.nexusmods.com/public/style_emoticons/dark/smile.gif[/img][/size]

[center][color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b]I[/b][b]f there's any bug﻿ or some dialogues are not well written, please let me know. I hope you enjoy even more your experience in Stardew Valley with this mod![/b][/size][/color][/center]
